text:
Maya: FYI, staging rack 7 arrived at DC-B this morning. Nodes booted but r7-n02 and r7-n03 report BIOS v1.2; our baseline is v1.3. procurement manifest RESV-3421 shows SKU mismatch for those two units.

TJ: can you paste the manifest id and hostnames so i can correlate with the reservation?

Maya: RESV-3421 - hosts r7-n02, r7-n03. Vendor notes indicate they shipped 1U-XL (no TPM fw) instead of 1U-XL-P (TPM-enabled).

Alejandra: darn. do we have a fallback to still hit tomorrow's canary? i can attempt a remote BIOS flash, but TPM image is vendor-signed.

Maya: fallback pool eu-canary-2 currently has 3 spare nodes reserved under RESV-3410. we could run the smoke there if vendor image ETA > 24h. Canary smoke is scheduled 2026-03-19T09:00:00-08:00 (PST).

Shawn: tagging @infra-team — if the flash can't land in time i can prep a terraform remap to move r7-n02/03 into the quarantine allocation and point their workloads to eu-canary-2.

Sam: vendor confirmed they host a signed TPM image and provide an IPMI flashing tool. Tested command (on similar board):

```
vendor-ipmi --host r7-n02 --user admin --flash /tmp/vendor-tpm-v1.3.bin --reboot
```

Notes: requires on-site power cycle permissions and OOB network reachability. I'll coordinate vendor OOB creds.

InfraBot: reservation RESV-3421 flagged: manifest mismatch (2 SKUs). Ticket created: #INF-788.

Alejandra: i'll be on-site tomorrow 07:30 PST to perform the flash if vendor can hand over the image. if not, we need the terraform change merged before the canary window.

Maya: i opened a PR to add quarantine mapping and a short allocation tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-terraform/pull/482. @Shawn can you review? :eyes: 

Shawn: looking now. quick suggestion: add tag `quarantine=true` and include a short rollback note in the deploy doc (use `terraform apply -target=module.rack7` to limit scope on revert).

Alejandra: will add the IPMI runbook step and vendor image checksum verification to the PR comments.

Eva: heads-up — finance asked about impact on reserved vs used capacity. do we need to update dashboards if we consume eu-canary-2 nodes for the smoke?

Maya: small delta; 3 nodes from eu-canary-2 are within our weekly slack for dedicated. i'll update the console capacity dashboard and ping finance if flash ETA slips beyond 24h. :thumbsup:

TJ: action summary: 1) Alejandra on-site 07:30 PST to attempt vendor flash. 2) Shawn to review & merge PR #482 (add quarantine tag) before 08:30 PST. 3) Maya updates console and notifies finance if delay > 24h. 4) Sam finalizes vendor OOB access and image checksum. keep updates in this thread.

Sam: vendor call at 06:45 PST — i'll confirm checksum and remote-flash window, will post results here.

Maya: thanks — i'm marking this thread as canonical status for r7. i'll post PR merge / flash outcome here as soon as i have it.
